Episode 197: Shadow Tribe (4)

With a whoosh and a crunch, the beastmen pulled into Rakiman's hand quickly shrunk to an unrecognizable size. When Rakiman clenched his fist, the beastmen crushed like mashed apples, and blood flowed between Rakiman's giant fists.
Just like drinking the juice of a medicinal herb.
Rakiman lifted his hand and swallowed the heavy drops of blood dripping from the beastmen. While his throat was gurgling disgustingly, the Kinzelos dared not think about attacking.
'What the hell... is he...'

Bardrei, who had been chuckling as if amused, instantly hardened his expression. Berakt understood the fear that the lower ones had been feeling all this time. The peaks of the terrestrial combat tribes were trembling.
The intuition that he could not stand against him.
The certainty that they must run.
The beastly instinct of the beastmen told them. Rakiman Hog, that monster, was a predator to be avoided, not an enemy to fight and win.
It wasn't a matter of power gap.

Rakiman, who had just woken up from the seal, couldn't even operate 30% of the power he originally possessed. Berakt and Bardrei recognized that he was not in a normal state and knew that they had a high chance of winning if they fought properly now.
But they couldn't overcome their fear easily.
"I've felt this since last time, but the taste of the blood isn't very good. Is this the limit of the hybrids?"
Whoosh!
Another group of beastmen were sucked into Rakiman's hand. Upon seeing it again, the spread red aura was pulling and crushing the beastmen like a net.
In that way, without any hindrance, Rakiman took another sip of condensed blood. The bodies of the beastmen oxidized into the aura and became black dust, scattering.
"I told everyone to run away!"
Berakt shouted again, but the beastmen were no different from flies caught in a spider's web. They couldn't move a finger, and they couldn't even hear Berakt's voice.
'I shouldn't have set off the flare...!'
The patrolling groups would have gathered anyway due to the flares set off by the Shadow Tribe.
But the whole division of the branch wouldn't have moved, and if they hadn't, he could have issued an order to abandon the branch and evacuate everyone to the headquarters.
"Stop it, you monster bastard!"
Bardrei said, stabbing his great sword next to the neck of the fallen Shadow Tribe members.
"You just said they're your fellow tribesmen, right? It seems you care for your kind, but if you move once more, their necks and bodies will part forever...!"
Of course, Rakiman didn't stop his meal even at Bardrei's desperate threat. Another group of beastmen lost their lives to Rakiman's outstretched hand.

It's not that Rakiman despises the lives of the soldiers. His love for his fellow tribesmen is greater than anyone else's, but he believes in bestowing the honor of becoming an immortal soldier even after death.
"You hybrid bunch don't know our Shadow Tribe, so you can make such threats."

"Don't want to know, okay? Can't you think of it as negotiation instead of threat? Just as you said at first, we'll take these guys and go back quietly. Let's not get too tired. Your body doesn't seem to be in good shape either."

"It's commendable to see you muster courage even though you must be scared. I will give you one last chance to choose. Will the two of you become servants of the Shadow Tribe, or will you resist in vain?"
"What would you do if we become servants?"
"I'll spare the two of you and make good use of you."
"And the rest?"
"They become food for me and my fellow tribesmen."
Roar!
Finally shaking off his fear, Berakt charged at Rakiman and swung his great sword. However, he couldn't penetrate the shield formed by Rakiman's red aura.
That's because he hadn't yet fully regained his composure as a 10-star warrior. There was a hint of hesitation unique to those consumed by fear in Berakt's attack.
"Bardrei, take the underlings and run. I'll buy as much time as possible."

The newly arrived reinforcements were freezing in place as soon as they saw Rakiman. The demons were somewhat better off, but they too felt fear seeing the petrified beastmen and the more cowed grand warriors than ever before.
"So shall we do that? Damn it, what the hell is that!"
Boom...!
Suddenly, a distant explosion was heard. Bardrei and Berakt quickly turned their heads to confirm the direction, and red lightning was falling from the entire sky.
It was from the side where the branch was.
The other hidden Shadow Tribesmen started moving. At the same time, a rectangular screen floated up from Rakiman's bracelet, revealing the face of another Shadow Tribesman.
{Shadow King Rakiman, we have successfully suppressed all the hybrids in the building. There are demons escaping, but Brother Ogen has taken over the tracking and elimination.}
It was Andollin.
It took 15 seconds for her and the other Shadow Tribe infiltrators to occupy the branch.

"You're both here, Berakt and Badrei, so in fact, the occupation of the base was over the moment the Red Plutonian appeared. Ordinary soldiers and assault captain-level beastmen can't even stand against the energy of ordinary Red Plutonian. And if you have two returning martial kings, resistance was unthinkable.
"Since Brother Ozen has almost fully regained his power, there won't be any problems. Any other peculiarities?"

{...There are experimental bodies resembling the Blue Plutonian in the basement of the building. They seem to be failed biological golems that mimic the Blue Plutonian. Luckily, the basement was not completely destroyed by the lightning energy shot by me and my brothers, so we were able to confirm it.}
"I see, in many ways, this is an interesting time, now on the surface. Got it, I'll be heading your way soon. Brothers, don't save my portion and fill your stomachs to your heart's content."
{Red Plutonian!}
Andorin saluted the Red Plutonian with a courteous gesture, placing her hand on her chest, and the window floating above the bracelet disappeared.
'The base is already over...?'
'Even if you're kidding, you can't kid like this. How many of these guys are there?'
Listening to the conversation, Berakt and Badrei had to pull themselves together once again.
"This son of a bitch, he said he would go quietly if he just released his brothers. He had already prepared to hit us?"
"Red Plutonian does not lie. You hybrids just failed to recognize an opportunity more precious than gold."

"Cut the crap! You're having fun, huh? Just watch, it won't end just with you guys laughing today. No matter who is behind you, we'll find out and exterminate you. It's an all-out war from now on, bastards!"
At that, Rakiman burst out in a low laugh, like boiling iron.

"Bardei, who has been hiding, and Berakt, with white fur. You two are reported to be among the strongest in the world right now, but I am disappointed. Is Jin Runcandel, the human, on a similar level as you two?"
"Why are you suddenly asking about Runcandel's lineage?"

"If you don't know, tell me about Orgal, your leader. Where is he? Although insignificant, he is the head of one of the four major forces in the world, so I want to have a conversation at least once."
"If you wanted a conversation, you should have asked before this slaughter. As Badrei said, the only thing left between you Red Plutonian and our Kinzelo is an all-out war."
"You're rejecting valuable mercy again... That's why you're nothing more than hybrids."
Rakiman's two eyes gathered energy, red as blood.
Then Berakt and Badrei felt a suppressing fear grow even larger, and all the nearby beastmen fell flat on the ground.
In Rakiman's hands, red energy formed a massive sword. As the two red swords vibrated, the space distorted with the spreading energy.
"Come, hybrids. The power I have now is not greater than yours, but I'll wake you up to what the dignity of the greatest race among all mortals in the world is."
“Kaaah!”
“Die, die, die!”

The battle cries from Beraqt and Badrei were like spells they cast on themselves. They had to force themselves to fight, because if they didn't, they wouldn't be able to. Among the beastmen who faced a Jikmyeong of the Red Plutonian tribe in the world, only these two were able to maintain their sanity.
The battle was one-sided from the start.
Rakiman swung his sword lightly, as if enjoying a game, without straining, and the two of them resisted him with all their might at every moment.
Even so, Beraqt and Badrei couldn't even display half of their original abilities. As Rakiman said, there was an insurmountable wall and gap between predator and prey.
So, within about ten minutes.
Beraqt and Badrei had no choice but to decide to retreat. It was shameful, but they had to survive to report this fact to the headquarters and prepare to fight again.

Rakiman saw right through their intentions. The desperation to escape, the fear that they couldn't resist even though they definitely had more power than they did now, the humiliation of being less than a common soldier in an instant after always being losers.
He read all these emotions and enjoyed the thrill of the hunt.
Soon, the two beastmen, who were the symbols of the martial strength of the world's terrestrial races, showed the image of running haphazardly like frightened children.
In the end, the instinct to live crushed the last remaining pride. Beraqt and Badrei, especially Beraqt, had never experienced such great humiliation since birth.
Rakiman couldn't chase the running duo. Because his physical abilities were still inferior to theirs.
He also didn't feel the need to catch them at all costs. They were prey that would be better when they were cooked more thoroughly anyway.
Instead, Rakiman gathered his strength once and shot a sword aura towards them. To get the highly pure blood that he needed to eat right now.
Swoosh-!
The aura cut off Badrei's left arm. Badrei kept running without looking back even at the moment his arm was cut off.
Afterwards, Rakiman did not chase them as they quickly disappeared from his sight. He just walked leisurely, as if he were taking a walk, to collect the fallen arm and the blood contained within.
“Indeed, an excellent nourishment. I should share half with my Shimat brothers.”
After picking up Badrei's fallen arm, Rakiman looked at a rock in the distance. He had been aware of that rock for a while. To be exact, he was aware of a human hiding behind it.

"Yona Runcandel. If my guess is correct, you must be the sister of Jin Runcandel. I heard that you and the Nameless King are the only humans in the world who can hide so well. Now you will tell your brother what you have been spying on."
Yona.
As Rakiman said, she had been watching the situation all along. Recently, she had been hiding in the land of the beastmen at Jin's request.
“So when you go back, tell your brother this. Even now, if he kills Ameris and betrays the Blue Plutonian tribe, I'll leave open the possibility of becoming a brother of Red Plutonian.”
